{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_patients}")

# Check how many times each patient appears
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_counts = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f"Patients with multiple entries: {len(duplicate_counts)}")
print(f"Distribution of multiple entries: {duplicate_counts.values}")

# Identify the highest sample_seq per patient
max_sample_seq = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
# This deduplicates on patient_id, keeping the latest test
data_dedup = data.merge(max_sample_seq.reset_index(), on=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], how='inner')

# Verify deduplication worked
print(f"After deduplication, number of rows: {len(data_dedup)}")
print(f"Number of unique patients: {data_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")"}
